title: DeepSeek Cold Atom Scan Report 2026-08-09

canonical_node.axiom: The canonical atom ledger must be reconciled to the 2026-08-09 canonical revision; any atom not updated after that date is suspect for drift.
definitions: Canonical revision: the 2026-08-09 document that fixes the Master Equation, four axioms, three levels, and ten laws.
Atom: a ledger entry with an ID and status; not necessarily containing full claim text.
Drift: any atom that conflicts with the canonical revision, e.g., asserting a fifth axiom or old law numbering.
ORPHANED: an atom that is active_candidate_unanchored and lacks a physics-side anchor atom.
derivation: The ledger contains 268 atoms, but only 2 are in the master-equation namespace.
The canonical document covers many claims (e.g., Level 0, gradient dynamics, Ten Laws, conservation results) that have no corresponding ledger atoms.
The sample atom tp:ME/L5/C1 is not present in the ledger, indicating a ledger integrity failure.
198 atoms are NOT_ESTABLISHED, 44 are ISOMORPHIC_EVENT_CANDIDATE, 10 are BRIDGE_DECLARED, and many are active_candidate_unanchored.
Therefore, the ledger is an unverified scaffold, not a canonical atom base.
canonical_node.action: Reconcile the ledger to the 2026-08-09 canonical revision; add missing load-bearing atoms; add or retire the sample atom; reclassify unanchored atoms as ORPHANED; quarantine python-colab-runtime-lane; re-run audit after each law and spiritual family has a typed atom with kill condition.
boundary: This document does not provide full claim text for atoms; atom-to-claim mapping is ID-inferred.
This document does not establish any new physics or theology; it only audits ledger completeness.
This document does not claim that the canon is dishonest; it finds the ledger incomplete.
test: Check that every canonical claim listed in the audit has a corresponding ledger atom with status not NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Verify that no atom asserts a fifth axiom or old law numbering.
Verify that all active_candidate_unanchored atoms are reclassified as ORPHANED.
Verify that the sample atom tp:ME/L5/C1 is either added to the ledger or formally retired.

overstatement_risks: Treating the audit's ID-inferred mappings as verified claim text.
Assuming the ledger's statuses are accurate without full claim-text audit.
Using the audit's priority list as a substitute for actual atom creation.
kill_conditions: If the canonical revision is superseded before reconciliation.
If the ledger is found to contain fabricated atoms.
If the audit's recommendations are ignored and the ledger remains incomplete.
risk.lean_target: A machine-checkable ledger where every canonical claim has a typed atom with a kill condition.

plain_summary: This document is an audit report that finds the atom ledger severely incomplete relative to the canonical revision. It identifies gaps, drift, and unanchored atoms, and recommends reconciliation and atom creation. It does not establish any new claims; it is a structural integrity review.
